# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher at the Carmody school  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>

## Appearance

Ruby is a handsome, fair young lady with large, bright-blue eyes, a brilliant, showy complexion, and a plump, showy figure. She has long golden hair, which she wore in a long yellow braid during her school days and later styled up when away from home. Mrs. Rachel Lynde describes her looks as very showy with snap and color.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c28 P3](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0003), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## Personality

Ruby is cheerful, good-tempered, nervous, and laughs a great deal, frankly enjoying the pleasant things in life. She is inclined to be hysterical and cry when frightened or overwhelmed. Even as a child, she was obsessed with thoughts of young men, suitors, and romance, growing increasingly focused on them as she grew older.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c28 P13](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0013), [v1 c28 P36](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0036), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)_

- to have dozens of beaus and a gay time before settling down  <sub>[v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)</sub>

## History

While attending Avonlea school, Ruby shared treats with Anne Shirley, participated in class events such as dialogues, and took part in a concert tableau of 'Faith, Hope and Charity'. She climbed a high willow tree on a dare from Carrie Sloane despite her fear of caterpillars. When Anne was injured playing games, Ruby panicked and succumbed to hysterics. She was accepted into the Queen's Academy class, passed the Entrance examinations halfway up the list, and studied to obtain a teaching license with the goal of teaching for two years before getting married. Upon completing Queen's, she secured a position teaching at Carmody school. There, she continued to draw numerous suitors, including Nelson Atkins and Wilbur Blair, boasting to her friends about her romantic conquests.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c17 P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v2 c26 P56](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0056), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)_
